create_dispatch_policy: create a dispatch policy by name and number of instances for a disaggregated pipeline
build_round_robin_policy: build a round-robin dispatch policy that cycles through encoder, denoiser, or decoder instances
build_max_free_slots_policy: build a max-free-slots dispatch policy that selects the instance with the most available capacity
create_pool_dispatcher: create a pool dispatcher wrapping independent dispatch policies for encoder, denoiser, and decoder pools
test_select_with_capacity: test dispatch policy selection with capacity awareness returning an instance id or none when all are full
